title.zh: 【Ethena：对币安未实现盈亏敞口约 880 万美元，远低于储备基金】
title.en: 【Ethena：对币安未实现盈亏敞口约 880 万美元，远低于储备基金】

current_state.zh: Ethena said its unrealized PnL exposure to Binance totals about $8.8 million — far below its over $60 million excess reserve fund — with collateral held at off-exchange custodians and third-party proof of reserves due within hours, amid on-chain reports of a suspected Binance hot wallet attack.
